title: Meta's Broken Promises: Systemic Censorship of Palestine Content on Instagram and Facebook
summary: Comprehensive 51-page human rights investigation analyzing 1,050+ cases across 60+ countries, documenting that Meta platforms (Instagram, Facebook) systematically silenced peaceful political speech, human rights documentation, and civilian casualty reporting via automated AI content moderation, shadowbanning, and algorithmic suppression aligned with state foreign policy directives.
